name: apple-card-carousel
blurb: Horizontal scrollable card carousel with click-to-expand modal detail view.
description: Carousel of large image cards that expands to a full-screen modal with shared layout animations when clicked. Includes blur-on-load for images, scroll buttons, and keyboard/outside-click close handling.
use_when: Showcasing high-quality images or products in an Apple-like polished carousel with detail views.
avoid_when: Mobile-only interfaces; the component is optimized for mouse scroll and click.
a11y: Cards are clickable buttons with keyboard support (Escape to close). Modal has proper focus management and backdrop.
